strikeRange.note: How far a strike reaches (a slime's size adds to it)

strikeMs.note: The shortest time between two strikes

flashMs.note: How long a strike shows on every screen

swingMs.note: The swipe around the hero, and its smear as it carries through

hitStopMs.note: The hit lands: the slime freezes, white, before it is pushed

slimePush.note: How far a strike pushes a slime back

lunge.note: The hero steps into each strike (as far as the push, so a combo stays in reach)

pushMs.note: How long the push takes (it eases out)

wobble.note: How much a struck slime squashes and wobbles

wobbleMs.note: How long the wobble takes to die away (overlap)

shake.note: The camera's kick when your strike lands
